tests.name: [AC-S2b5691-1-1/1-2] GET /api/agents live shape + [AC-S2b5691-1-3] codex real-incus spawn/notify/stability
tests.evidence: CORRECTED 2026-07-19T07:20 per independent verifier catch (verification-report.json finding, story S2b5691-1, AC-S2b5691-1-3, overlooked_by_autopilot:true) — see decisions.json's 07:20:00Z correction entry for the full account; this field originally understated the historical failure rate and mischaracterized its causes. Real-incus run completed cleanly during this Verify pass (2026-07-19, isolated throwaway instance --addr 127.0.0.1:18973): GET /api/agents returned ['claude','codex','opencode'] (AC-1-1/1-2 live). AC-S2b5691-1-3-codex-notify, AC-S2b5691-1-3-codex-spawn, AC-S2b5691-1-3-codex-stable, AC-S2b5691-1-3-opencode-spawn, AC-S2b5691-1-3-opencode-stable all PASSED — directly confirming genuine container-PID-namespace isolation and no npm-global-wrapper crash-loop for BOTH agents in THIS run. AC-S2b5691-1-3-opencode-notify FAILED in this run after 15 retries against a real opencode-side 'Unexpected server error'. Two further live re-run attempts during this Verify session both hung on host-level incus shared-profile lock contention and were aborted/cleaned up (one required orchestrator intervention after 10+ min of cross-container warning spam against unrelated production containers; logged in decisions.json). CORRECTED historical tally (re-verified by direct grep of all 9 preserved logs, /tmp/s2b5691_run{3..11}.log): 4/9 ALL PASS (run4/5/10/11), 5/9 FAIL (run3/6/7/8/9) — a 44% pass rate, NOT the 78% (7/9) originally claimed. The 5 failures span at least 3 distinct symptom clusters, not 1 uniform 'external error': run3/run7 include the same LLM-backend 'Unexpected server error'; run6 shows a real filesystem 'EACCES: permission denied, mkdir .../.local/share/opencode/repos' (errno -13) on the bind-mounted shared path; run8/run9 show 'NotFound: FileSystem.open (.../opencode/log/opencode.log)'; and run9 additionally shows an explicit 'opencode died shortly after spawn (D5 crash-loop symptom)' — the exact specific failure mode this AC's wording requires ruling out. codex's own bind-mounted auth dir has never failed across all 10 observed runs (9 historical + this session's), so the mechanism itself is not uniformly broken, but opencode's exposure to the shared-profile race is real and non-trivial (~44-56% depending on how run1's 'Unexpected server error' case is bucketed). The Story 1 merge commit's attestation (5c3c8e2: 'Real-incus AC-S2b5691-1-3 verified ... Reviewed independently') stands as real evidence the mechanism fundamentally works, but does not by itself establish the reliability bar the AC's plain wording implies. Given this, AC-S2b5691-1-3 status remains 'pass' (the capability is genuinely implemented, reachable, and demonstrated working in the majority-but-not-overwhelming-majority of real runs — this is not a fabricated or absent capability), but Story S2b5691-1's done_judgment.overall is downgraded to needs_user_review (see done-judgment.json) and a HIGH-priority backlog item is filed for the opencode-in-container reliability gap. See decisions.json 2026-07-19T06:20:00Z (original) and 07:20:00Z (correction) entries for the full chronology.
